notes: Added a new FEHA Credits Wallet showing the selected actor name and live Credits balance, with direct numeric editing and SAVE CREDITS.
Credits is now canonical at flags.fleshEnshrouded.credits. Existing character balances migrate from the old GP/Eurodollar setup without summing duplicate mirror fields.
Legacy ADKWallet getEuro/setEuro/add/spend/format calls remain compatibility aliases to the Credits balance so Market purchase/refund logic continues to use the same money.
Legacy nested wallet euro/eurodollars/money fields are cleaned during writes. D&D GP and root eurodollars remain compatibility mirrors only; Credits is authoritative.
Visible ADK currency labels are normalized from €$/Eurodollar/eddies to CR/Credits across Market, Chrome Manager, Cyberdeck, and the new wallet.
Wallet saves refresh open Market/Chrome surfaces and include FEHA scan/confirm/error/close/open sound feedback.
Moved Market audio into the same proven global FEHA sound router used by Chrome Manager instead of relying on a separate Market binder.
Storefront cards now use drawer_open; vendor tier buttons use subsystem_select; ITEM MK uses cyberware_select; category filters and pagination use select.
DETAILS uses scan; item art uses cyberware_select; item names use drawer_open; BUY uses install; reroll uses scan; reset uses remove; wallet uses drawer_open; back/close use drawer_close.
Market actor/manufacturer/body-slot select changes are handled by the same global change router.
Disabled the separate Market sound binder to prevent duplicate playback.
Market sounds now bind directly to every rendered Market button instead of relying on root/document delegation; a MutationObserver rebinds newly-rendered controls after Market rerenders.

Different Market interactions use different existing sound families: storefront/open/back/directory, tier/category/Mk filters, reroll, DETAILS, item art/name, BUY, pagination, reset, wallet, actor and dropdown changes.

DETAILS uses scan, item art uses cyberware_select, item name uses drawer_open, BUY uses install, reroll uses scan, tier uses subsystem_select, pagination/category use select, Mk uses cyberware_select, reset uses remove, and back/close use drawer_close.
Storefront sidebar readability increased substantially: wider rail, larger section labels, larger search text, larger filter/Mk chips, larger dropdowns, and larger reset control.
Replaced Market document-level click audio delegation with direct #adk-market-15 root binding.
Market button sounds now trigger on left-button pointerdown, before Market rerenders its directory/store/filter DOM.
A MutationObserver binds every newly opened Market root automatically; inner Market rerenders keep the same working root listener.
Removed Market click cooldowns so each deliberate button press gets immediate tactile feedback; hover audio remains disabled.

Pulled Market closer to the FEHA application family without copying the Cyberdeck terminal skin: clipped geometry, harder black/cyan shell, yellow action language, red currency emphasis, diagnostic microtext, and restrained scan motion.
Market BUY actions are now consistently yellow while item Mk tier color remains on item framing/badges.

Added Market click sounds with no hover audio. Store entry/details/wallet use drawer cues; tier/category/manufacturer/slot controls use system cues; Mk/pagination/general controls use lighter UI cues; reroll uses scan; buy uses install; reset uses remove; close/back use drawer_close.
Market sound binding lives outside the Market render tree so it survives directory/store/filter rerenders.
Rebuilt the ADK Market presentation layer while preserving the existing Market 1.6 data, stock, purchase, wallet, capacity, permission, reroll, filtering, pagination, and DETAILS behavior.
Replaced the old pink/brown Market skin with a distinct dark Night Market application using cyan navigation, red currency emphasis, vendor-tier accents, and per-storefront identities.
Reworked the directory hierarchy, vendor clearance selector, six storefront cards, header controls, storefront sidebar, store header, item cards, purchase states, empty state, and pagination.
Item Mk colors remain item-driven; vendor clearance remains vendor-tier driven.
Responsive layouts keep directory, filters, product grid, and details usable at narrower Market window sizes.
Fixed the actual JACK IN zoom minus button: zoom-out now uses the same confirmed-working select click as zoom-in, with zero cooldown.
Changed JACK IN zoom-out/minus click from subsystem_select to cyberware_select so the minus button uses a sound confirmed available in the active pack.
Removed blanket hover audio from Cyberdeck/JACK IN; sound now triggers from clicks/actions only.
